hero.headline: From Interface Physics to Reliable Electronic Systems.
hero.description: I investigate how interfaces, defects, and electronic and ionic transport govern memory operation, device variability, and reliability. My research connects physical mechanisms with experimental devices, arrays, and circuit-level functionality across semiconductor and emerging electronic platforms.

work.title: Research Work
work.headline: Physical mechanisms demonstrated in functional hardware.

features.title: Interface-Engineered Synapses for Reliable Neuromorphic Computing
features.description: Hydrogen-bond engineering improves analog memory stability and switching behavior, connecting interface control with crossbar-array operation and CNN-based neuromorphic computation.

features.title: Helicity-Defined Analog Memory with Circuit-Level Validation
features.description: Optical helicity defines persistent analog conductance states, with array-level operation, ADC/FPGA-assisted readout, and mixed-signal vector–matrix computation.

breadthParagraphs: My broader work spans memory devices, semiconductor interfaces, molecular electronics, photodetection, photovoltaics, and flexible electronics, with a recurring focus on transport, variability, and reliability.
work.journalStatement: First-author and collaborative research published in Advanced Materials, ACS Nano, Advanced Functional Materials, and other leading journals.

outlook.title: Research Outlook
outlook.headline: From Understanding Devices to Engineering Reliable Systems.
outlook.introduction: I aim to connect device physics with reliable memory, computing hardware, and integrated electronic systems.

directions.title: Predictive Memory Reliability
directions.description: Understanding how defects, noise, and leakage shape memory variability and lifetime.

directions.title: Hardware-Aware Memory Computing
directions.description: Connecting device nonidealities with array accuracy and peripheral circuits.

directions.title: Integrated & Adaptive Electronics
directions.description: Extending interface and device research toward adaptive, integrated platforms.
